proposals: For the Pitt St Mall zone (340) and the King St bicycle-path zone (343), a per-slot phantom filter could keep the real riders on burst days instead of dropping whole days: set missing only the slots where the zone's count is far above its usual time-of-day level and the camera's IN total exceeds its OUT total by a matching amount. For now whole burst days are set missing.

useful: counter_days: IN/OUT/NONE totals exposed the phantom bursts (IN rising with no OUT) and the April-July 2025 outage and zone drop-outs
zeros(counter=True): listed the whole-camera outages directly
spikes: pointed at 340 and 343 as the burst zones
compare: the ratio against piezo neighbours 548/559 showed the Oct 2024 step was the camera, not demand
daily(wide=True) and directions: showed both directions of 340 and 343 inflating together
slots: pinned the step to midday 2024-10-02 and the restart to 12:30 on 2025-07-16
not_useful: absent_zeros: returned nothing although 731/867/859 lose their zero slots from mid 2025 (these zones have mostly-zero days, so whole days vanish rather than weeks lacking zeros)
doubled/duplicates: nothing relevant for this single-record camera
improve: absent_zeros: also flag directions that miss whole days, or days with only non-zero slots, while the counter's other zones are complete
spikes: add a per-day summary and the camera's IN-OUT imbalance for the same slots, to tell phantom bursts from real crowds
compare: allow a per-direction breakdown so zones can be set against a single piezo direction
add: A camera flow-balance tool: per slot or day, IN vs OUT totals and each zone's deviation from its usual, to find zones producing detections that never leave the intersection
A step detector: per counter, the date where the ratio to nearby counters changes most, with before/after levels

summary: One Secure Agility camera at King St / Pitt St with nine zones. It failed from 25 April to 16 July 2025 and had five short outages, which are set missing; after the restart the feed drops zero slots for the quiet zones, which are zero-filled. The Pitt St Mall footpath zone (340) and the King St bicycle-path zone (343) have frequent phantom bursts (IN detections with no matching OUT), and those days are set missing. The camera's detection stepped up 2-10x on 2 October 2024 while nearby piezos stayed flat, so each direction is split into before and after series.
